'At the start of your turn, destroy this and your next sword attack this turn gets +3{p}.' Warrior Action - Aura (MasteryPackWarrior).

SHAPE copied from .drafts/crash_down_yellow.json - same family, same printed sentence shape ('At the start of your turn, destroy this and your next <X> attack this turn gets +N{p}'), differing only in the filter and amount.

TRIGGER VEHICLE: START_OF_TURN is dispatched by engine._dsl_start_of_turn_listener (engine.py:1461-1466) to the ACTIVE player's zones only, and _dsl_permanent_zones (engine.py:1452-1459) includes player.auras - a played Aura sits there, so on its controller's turn the ability fires with no IS_ACTIVE_PLAYER gate needed. Release note ('neither player has priority during the start of turn when this resolves') describes engine timing, not card behaviour - nothing to author.

EFFECT ORDER follows the printed sentence: DESTROY_SELF first (effect_types.py:2470 shares the DESTROY_PERMANENT branch; the bare form destroys the source via canonical destroy(), which resolves the aura zone itself), then MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK queues on the controller's dsl_queued_attack_mods (handler effect_types.py:4592-4618 READS mod/amount/filter/scope - verified). Destroying the aura first cannot unqueue the pump: the entry lives on the player, not the card. One-shot consumption by the first qualifying attack IS 'the next'; unused entries expire end of turn, which is 'this turn' (scope left at default TURN).

FILTER names a SWORD attack. Per DSL_REFERENCE's filter table, sword is a SUBTYPE (swords are weapons, which attack as themselves), so ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN alone is the whole filter - unlike crash_down's three-clause 'Guardian attack action card'. Handler verified: condition_types.py:296-316 reads 'subtypes' and tests them against the attack card's subtypes AND types merged, plus a 'weapon' flag when combat.from_weapon is set, so a Sword weapon attack matches on its printed subtype.

No printed keywords (printed_keywords empty); no play cost or conditions in the text; nothing else to author.
